context: Asuka praises Sho's growth at school.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: しょうくん、随分、成長したね。
lines.style: Warm, steady gaze. Opens with genuine delight in the observation. Soft voice, patient pacing. Real affection threading through — not performative, but felt. The tone of an adult who sees a child clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, sincere. A small voice meeting her eyes for a moment. Genuine gratitude without self-consciousness. Gentle, unhurried — the warmth of a child who feels safe.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: You're kind to your friends too.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Slight smile in the voice. Gentle emphasis on the observation itself, not on praising. Steady, approving. The tone of someone noticing what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, honest. A small brightness in the voice without forcing it. Simple and direct — the unselfconscious warmth of a child who means what he says. Gentle rhythm, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: And you work hard at your studies too.
lines.style: Appreciative, calm. Light emphasis on 'too' — acknowledging the fullness of his effort across everything. Warm, steady delivery. The voice of someone tallying up the real growth they see.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft wonder. A simple statement carrying genuine feeling. Unhurried, sincere — the natural openness of a child speaking truth. Small, genuine. No performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 誇りに、思ってる、しょうくん。
lines.en: I'm really proud of you, Sho-kun.
lines.style: Warm, direct, closing with quiet conviction. Slight softening on his name. The words land gently but with real weight — not effusive, but genuinely felt. The tone of an adult giving a gift of recognition.
